name: Grade 9 IT Practice: April Week 5 - Serial and Analog
description: Practice words for Grade 9 first-trimester physical computing work.

words.definition: A tool that shows messages from a program.
words.example: The serial monitor displayed the live sensor readings.

words.definition: The speed used for serial messages.
words.example: The baud rate in the code matched the serial monitor setting.

words.definition: Facts or values that can be used or studied.
words.example: The Arduino sent sensor data to the computer every second.
The serial message showed the current potentiometer value.

words.definition: A changing sensor value read by a board.
words.example: The potentiometer was connected to an analog input pin.

words.definition: A knob that changes an analog value.
words.example: Turning the potentiometer changed the number printed on the screen.

words.definition: How light or dark something is.
words.example: The LED brightness increased when the analog value got higher.
